description.en: The token of the first page to query.

description.zh: 资源ID，n 的取值范围为 [1, 50]
description.en: The IDs of resources. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

description.zh: 资源类型定义。取值：instance（实例）
description.en: The resource type. Set the value to instance.

description.zh:
实例的标签键。N的取值范围为**1**~**20**。

- 不能以`aliyun`、`acs:`、`http://`或`https://`开头。
- 最多支持64个字符。
- 不允许传入空字符串。
description.en:
The key of tag N of the instance. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**.

- The key cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`.

- The key must be up to 64 characters in length.

- The tag key cannot be an empty string.

description.zh:
Topic的标签值。**Key**和**Value**值必须同时输入或同时不输入。若同时输入表示根据Tag过滤符合条件的Topic，若不输入表示查询所有Topic。

- N的取值范围为1~20。
- 如果输入该值，取值允许为空字符串。
- 最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en:
The value of a tag that is attached to the topics you want to query. This parameter is not required. If you configure this parameter, you must also configure the **Key** parameter.\*\*\*\* If you include the Key and Value parameters in a request, Queries only the topics that use the specified tags. If you do not include these parameters in a request, Queries all topics that you can access.

- Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

- The value of this parameter can be an empty string.

- The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http\:// or https\://. The tag key cannot start with acs: or aliyun.

title.zh: 查询资源已经绑定的标签列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens list-tag-resources --resource-type instance --resource-id i-t252vwg7cib00ky8g0q --next-token 153ba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4123 --tag Value=tagValue Key=team --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'i-t252vwg7cib00ky8g0q' --Tag.1.Key team --NextToken 153ba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4123 --Tag.1.Value tagValue --ResourceType instance
